_doc: These are the base providers, one per harness, added once per machine. Merge them into .agents.providers in ~/.paseo/config.json, replacing OAUTH_TOKEN with your CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (`claude setup-token`) and ZAI_KEY with your z.ai key (`omp token zai` prints the one omp already has); every seat on a harness inherits its base through `extends`.

The per-project seats are not here. setup/setup-seats.fish composes them from harness/<id>/harness.json and seats.json, so a role's provider, its env, its model, and its deny map all follow one edit in seats.json.
Add a base entry only for a harness some role actually uses: seats.json decides which.
Paseo ships the omp provider disabled, so `enabled: true` is required on it, not optional.
A seat directory is its own omp agent directory with its own empty credential store, so an omp seat cannot share your `omp` login and reads ZAI_API_KEY instead.
Merge into the existing file; don't replace it, because it also holds workspaces and the agent ledger.
Also make sure .daemon.mcp has "enabled": true and "injectIntoAgents": true, or the Lead and Supervisor get no Paseo tools.
Delete the _doc key before writing: Paseo's schema rejects unknown keys.
